evidence.title: Data Center 4 on the Campus ZRH1
evidence.excerpt: Green's current Campus ZRH1 page says its fourth data center is under construction in Lupfig and is planned for commissioning in early 2027.

metadata.status_scope: The live facility page explicitly says the fourth data center on Campus ZRH1 is currently under construction. It supports one generic under_construction observation as of capture and no finer foundations, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, or operational stage.
metadata.project_scope: The source identifies Data Center 4 as one new building on the already multi-building Campus ZRH1. The record creates one campus container and one DC4 build project; it does not create or reclassify the three existing data centers, office space, emergency workstations, customer areas, or a unique site.
